## Walkthrough

This pull request introduces typed minimum value utility functions (minI32 and minU32) in the math module and replaces direct Math.min usage across assembly files with these new utility functions for consistent numeric type handling.

## Changes

| Cohort / File(s) | Summary |
|---|---|
| **Math Utility Addition** <br> `assembly/math.ts` | Added two new exported inline functions: minI32 (i32 comparison) and minU32 (u32 comparison), each implementing a simple ternary comparison. |
| **Math.min Replacements** <br> `assembly/arguments.ts`, `assembly/memory.ts`, `assembly/program-build.ts` | Replaced direct Math.min calls with typed minI32 or minU32 utility functions across decoder argument processing and memory boundary calculations; added corresponding imports. |
